						newh = Math.max(e.mh,window.RSIH);

						e.gw = Array.isArray(e.gw) ? e.gw : [e.gw];
						for (var i in e.rl) if (e.gw[i]===undefined || e.gw[i]===0) e.gw[i] = e.gw[i-1];
						e.gh = e.el===undefined || e.el==="" || (Array.isArray(e.el) && e.el.length==0)? e.gh : e.el;

<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-0111f410 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex" style="padding-right:var(--wp--preset--spacing--50);padding-left:var(--wp--preset--spacing--50)">

<div style="height:59px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<h1 class="wp-block-heading has-xx-large-font-size"><strong>Roubenky a</strong> <strong>dřevostavby</strong></h1>



<div style="height:31px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<p class="has-large-font-size"><strong>Poctivá řemeslná práce</strong></p>
</div>
</div>
</div></div>



<div class="wp-block-group alignfull has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-group-is-layout-d89aad35 wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained" style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0;padding-top:var(--wp--preset--spacing--50);padding-right:var(--wp--preset--spacing--50);padding-bottom:var(--wp--preset--spacing--50);padding-left:var(--wp--preset--spacing--50)">
<div class="wp-block-columns alignwide are-vertically-aligned-center is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-63307f24 wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-vertically-aligned-center is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:50%">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">O nás</h2>



<div style="height:31px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<p>Jsme tesařská a truhlářská firma z Pelešan u Turnova a specializujeme se na stavbu roubenek a dřevostaveb. Stavíme již více než 27 let a za tu dobu jsme postavili přes 80 roubenek a dřevostaveb v Českém Ráji a Jizerských horách. Máme dlouholeté zkušenosti s prací se dřevem a dbáme na precizní zpracování každého detailu. Máme vlastní špičkově vybavenou truhlářskou dílnu a stavebně truhlářské prvky si do staveb dodáváme sami. Stavby dodáváme dle požadavků subdodavatelsky a nebo na klíč.</p>



<div style="height:22px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>
</div>



<div class="wp-block-column is-vertically-aligned-center is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:50%">
<figure class="wp-block-image alignright size-full is-resized is-style-default wp-duotone-unset-2"><img loading="lazy" width="2560" height="1442" src="https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC00264-scaled.jpg" alt="" class="wp-image-268" style="aspect-ratio:1.3333333333333333;object-fit:cover;width:569px;height:auto" srcset="https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC00264-scaled.jpg 2560w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC00264-300x169.jpg 300w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC00264-1024x577.jpg 1024w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC00264-768x433.jpg 768w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC00264-1536x865.jpg 1536w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC00264-2048x1154.jpg 2048w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC00264-1170x658.jpg 1170w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC00264-760x428.jpg 760w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC00264-370x208.jpg 370w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC00264-270x152.jpg 270w" sizes="(max-width: 2560px) 100vw, 2560px"></figure>
</div>
</div>



<div style="height:32px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>
</div>



<div style="height:56px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Naše služby</h2>



<div id="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-columns-b35356d1" class="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-columns alignfull has-3-columns has-desktop-equal-layout has-tablet-equal-layout has-mobile-collapsedRows-layout has-vertical-center ticss-c00aadba"><div class="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-columns-overlay"></div><div class="innerblocks-wrap">
<div id="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-column-f7e265b7" class="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-column">
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full is-resized has-custom-border is-style-rounded wp-duotone-unset-4 is-style-rounded--3" style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0"><img loading="lazy" width="2560" height="1707" src="https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC0728-scaled.jpeg" alt="" class="wp-image-420" style="border-width:1px;border-radius:12px;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;width:140px" srcset="https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC0728-scaled.jpeg 2560w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC0728-300x200.jpeg 300w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC0728-1024x683.jpeg 1024w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC0728-768x512.jpeg 768w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC0728-1536x1024.jpeg 1536w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC0728-2048x1365.jpeg 2048w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC0728-760x507.jpeg 760w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/DSC0728-370x247.jpeg 370w" sizes="(max-width: 2560px) 100vw, 2560px"></figure>



<div style="height:11px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<h3 id="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-heading-dae0e1ca" class="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-heading wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-heading-dae0e1ca">Roubenky</h3>



<p class="has-text-align-center">Roubenky na klíč podle vašich představ, od návrhu až po finální realizaci. Nabízíme také rekonstrukce starých roubenek, kde zachováváme jejich historický charakter a přidáváme moderní prvky. Každý detail je pečlivě promyšlený, abyste se ve svém novém domově cítili komfortně a v souladu s přírodou.</p>
</div>



<div id="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-column-64a287dd" class="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-column">
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full is-resized has-custom-border is-style-rounded wp-duotone-unset-6 is-style-rounded--5"><img loading="lazy" width="2000" height="1330" src="https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Libosovice_11_DSC5983.jpg" alt="Dřevostavba" class="wp-image-180" style="border-width:1px;border-radius:12px;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;width:140px" srcset="https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Libosovice_11_DSC5983.jpg 2000w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Libosovice_11_DSC5983-300x200.jpg 300w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Libosovice_11_DSC5983-1024x681.jpg 1024w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Libosovice_11_DSC5983-768x511.jpg 768w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Libosovice_11_DSC5983-1536x1021.jpg 1536w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Libosovice_11_DSC5983-760x505.jpg 760w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Libosovice_11_DSC5983-370x246.jpg 370w" sizes="(max-width: 2000px) 100vw, 2000px"></figure>



<h3 id="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-heading-78452094" class="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-heading wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-heading-78452094">Dřevostavby a pergoly</h3>



<p class="has-text-align-center">Stavíme úsporné dřevostavby se sendvičovou skladbou, které kombinují moderní technologie, kvalitní tepelnou izolaci a dlouhou životnost pro maximální komfort bydlení. Každý dům navrhujeme individuálně s ohledem na potřeby klienta a energetickou efektivitu.</p>
</div>



<div id="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-column-d3920805" class="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-column">
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full is-resized has-custom-border is-style-rounded wp-duotone-unset-8 is-style-rounded--7"><img loading="lazy" width="2560" height="1707" src="https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/DSC0731-scaled.jpeg" alt="Schody" class="wp-image-175" style="border-width:1px;border-radius:12px;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover;width:140px" srcset="https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/DSC0731-scaled.jpeg 2560w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/DSC0731-300x200.jpeg 300w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/DSC0731-1024x683.jpeg 1024w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/DSC0731-768x512.jpeg 768w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/DSC0731-1536x1024.jpeg 1536w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/DSC0731-2048x1365.jpeg 2048w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/DSC0731-760x507.jpeg 760w, https://web.archive.org/web/20260212100324im_/http://simunek-roubenky.cz/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/DSC0731-370x247.jpeg 370w" sizes="(max-width: 2560px) 100vw, 2560px"></figure>



<h3 id="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-heading-b65ca6f4" class="wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-heading wp-block-themeisle-blocks-advanced-heading-b65ca6f4">Truhlářské práce</h3>



<p class="has-text-align-center">Nabízíme kompletní truhlářské práce na míru. Vyrábíme si sami vnitřní i venkovní schodiště, špaletová a eurookna, dveře včetně zárubní, zakázkový nábytek i dekorativní prvky z masivu. Každý kus zhotovujeme s důrazem na detail, funkčnost a dlouhou životnost. </p>
</div>
</div></div>



<div style="height:58px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>

<div style="height:73px" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<div class="wp-block-group alignfull has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-group-is-layout-d89aad35 wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained" style="margin-top:0;margin-bottom:0;padding-top:var(--wp--preset--spacing--50);padding-right:var(--wp--preset--spacing--50);padding-bottom:var(--wp--preset--spacing--50);padding-left:var(--wp--preset--spacing--50)">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center">Truhlářské práce</h2>



<div class="wp-block-group alignwide has-global-padding is-layout-constrained wp-container-core-group-is-layout-19e250f3 wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<div class="wp-block-group is-vertical is-content-justification-center is-layout-flex wp-container-core-group-is-layout-6329a8f3 wp-block-group-is-layout-flex">
<p class="has-text-align-center">Kromě stavby roubenek a dřevostaveb vyrábíme také kvalitní dřevěné prvky na míru. Dodáváme schody, okna, dveře, krovy, pergoly a další truhlářské prvky, které dotvářejí vzhled i funkčnost vašeho domova.&nbsp;</p>
</div>



<div style="height:var(--wp--preset--spacing--40)" aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-spacer"></div>



<div class="wp-block-columns alignwide is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-9503679e wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-vertically-aligned-center is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:40%">
<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Zahradní přístřešky a schody</h3>



<p>Navrhujeme a realizujeme pergoly, altány, zahradní přístřešky i menší stavby, včetně kvalitního zastřešení a nátěru, který prodlouží životnost dřeva a ochrání stavbu před povětrnostními vlivy.</p>



<p>Vyrábíme&nbsp;masivní schody do interiérů i exteriérů, včetně&nbsp;ručně zdobeného zábradlí. Kombinujeme tradiční vzhled s moderním pohodlím a důrazem na bezpečnost. Schodiště z naší dílny podtrhne charakter každého prostoru.</p>
</div>

<div class="wp-block-column is-vertically-aligned-center is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow" style="flex-basis:40%">
<h3 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-right">Vlastní výroba dveří a oken</h3>



<p class="has-text-align-right">Nabízíme&nbsp;vchodové i interiérové dveře&nbsp;vyráběné na míru podle vašich představ, včetně&nbsp;zdobných prvků, kování a povrchových úprav. Dřevěné branky zhotovujeme v různých stylech – od rustikálních po moderní – vždy s ohledem na architekturu domu a okolního prostoru.</p>



<p class="has-text-align-right">Zajišťujeme výrobu&nbsp;klasických špaletových i&nbsp;eurooken&nbsp;pro novostavby nebo rekonstruované objekty. Oba typy nabízíme včetně&nbsp;zdobených šambrán, které podtrhnou dobový styl celého domu a dodají estetickou hodnotu.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<script id="wp-block-template-skip-link-js-after">
	( function() {
		var skipLinkTarget = document.querySelector( 'main' ),
			sibling,
			skipLinkTargetID,
			skipLink;

		// Early exit if a skip-link target can't be located.
		if ( ! skipLinkTarget ) {
			return;
		}

		/*
		 * Get the site wrapper.
		 * The skip-link will be injected in the beginning of it.
		 */
		sibling = document.querySelector( '.wp-site-blocks' );

		// Early exit if the root element was not found.
		if ( ! sibling ) {
			return;
		}

		// Get the skip-link target's ID, and generate one if it doesn't exist.
		skipLinkTargetID = skipLinkTarget.id;
		if ( ! skipLinkTargetID ) {
			skipLinkTargetID = 'wp--skip-link--target';
			skipLinkTarget.id = skipLinkTargetID;
		}

		// Create the skip link.
		skipLink = document.createElement( 'a' );
		skipLink.classList.add( 'skip-link', 'screen-reader-text' );
		skipLink.id = 'wp-skip-link';
		skipLink.href = '#' + skipLinkTargetID;
		skipLink.innerText = 'Přeskočit na obsah';

		// Inject the skip link.
		sibling.parentElement.insertBefore( skipLink, sibling );
	}() );

//# sourceURL=wp-block-template-skip-link-js-after
</script>
